<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Pitborn Adept](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3140)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

One of the most common types of nephilim is the pitborn, who bear a demonic corruption infesting their mortal bloodline.

<column gap="tiny">

([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 20

<title level="2" right="Creature 3">[Pitborn Adept](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3140)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Human" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=627" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 266

**Perception** +6; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +9, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +9, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +7, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +9, [Outer Rifts Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +9, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +6, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +9, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +0

**Dex** +2

**Con** +0

**Int** +4

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Items**
[Explorer's Clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2), spellbook, [Staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=12)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +5 

**Ref** +7 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 29

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
staff +6 ([two-handed 1d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=198)),
**Damage** 1d6 bludgeoning

**Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 21, attack +11
- **Cantrips (2nd)**
[Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Tangle Vine](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713), [Telekinetic Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715), [Void Warp](/Spells.aspx?ID=1745)
- **1st**
[Charm](/Spells.aspx?ID=34), [Enfeeble](/Spells.aspx?ID=1513), [Force Barrage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1536)
- **2nd**
[Floating Flame](/Spells.aspx?ID=1533), [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164)

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 17
- **2nd**
[Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59)

**Drain Bonded Item** <actions string="Free Action" />  **Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** The adept hasn't acted yet on this turn; **Effect** The adept expends the power stored in its staff. This gives the adept the ability to cast one prepared spell it had already previously cast today (choosing a different spell rank each time), without spending a spell slot. The adept must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.

</column>
